### Settings appearance

- Settings now use Follow ChatGPT as their sole theme, matching the desktop app’s colors, typography, navigation, headings, grouped controls, corner radii, spacing, and control states. Palboo branding and features remain available.
- Light and dark palettes, locally available font faces, navigation, menus, tooltips, and reduced motion follow the connected host.
- Choose independent fonts and text sizes for settings, the chat sidebar, page overlay, desktop window, and edge/notch panel in Appearance & fonts. Existing preferences are retained, and each window can follow ChatGPT or use a local font and a relative or fixed size.

- Align segmented selection, model menus, and confirmation-content height with verified desktop motion. Ordinary settings menus open immediately, and tooltips no longer interrupt clicks.
- Keep interface previews at 16:9 and size individual feature previews to their content, with one consistent content frame and no empty square padding.
- Centralize feature enable switches in Feature switches, remove duplicate switches from detail pages, and simplify the model-group entry.
- Clarify the layout-preset drawer and keep model switches responsive when the first state request is slow or the settings tab opens in the background.
- Redesign compatibility integrations around CodexHost, with a connection overview, feature introduction, original repository link, and existing management actions.

### Connection settings

- Reorganize Startup & connection around connection status, launch behavior, updates, and run mode. Clear stale connected messages after a disconnection.
- Correct the website link to palboo.0xtotoro.com.

### 设置外观

- 设置页统一使用「跟随 ChatGPT」，同步桌面应用的颜色、字体、字号、导航、标题、分组控件、圆角、间距和控件状态；保留 Palboo 品牌和现有功能。
- 浅色与深色配色、本机可用字形、导航、菜单、悬停提示及减少动态效果跟随当前连接的宿主。
- 在「外观与字体」分别设置设置页、聊天侧栏、页面浮层、桌面窗口和贴边／刘海的字体与字号。旧偏好继续保留；每类窗口可跟随 ChatGPT，或选择本机字体及相对／固定大小。

- 按桌面组件对齐分段选中、模型菜单和确认框内容高度动效；普通设置菜单即时开合，修复提示层偶发抢占点击。
- 界面预览保持16:9，单项功能预览按内容自适应高度，采用统一的单层内容框，去掉空白方框。
- 各功能启用开关统一放在「功能开关」，移除详情页重复开关，简化模型分组入口。
- 整理布局预设抽屉，修复设置页后台打开或首次读取缓慢时模型开关迟迟不可用的问题。
- 兼容集成以 CodexHost 为当前兼容层，展示接入关系、功能介绍及原版仓库链接，保留运行和更新管理。

### 连接设置

- 按连接状态、启动行为、应用更新和运行模式整理「启动与连接」；断线后不再显示过期的已连接提示。
- 修正官网链接为 palboo.0xtotoro.com。
